title: India's digital payments system just crossed 800 million transactions a day
sources: StartupTalky - UPI Daily Transactions Cross 800 Million for the First Time: 24.07 Billion Transactions in September 2026
Angel One - UPI daily transactions crossed 800 million for first time in September 2026

scenes.text: India's digital payments system just crossed 800 million transactions a day.
UPI processed 24.07 billion transactions worth Rs 29.37 lakh crore in September 2026, averaging roughly 802 million transactions a day - the first month the system has ever crossed 800 million daily.

scenes.text: Average daily transaction value also hit a record Rs 97,913 crore. Year-on-year, transaction volume rose about 23 percent and value rose about 18 percent compared to September 2025.

scenes.text: The monthly total was slightly down from August's record 24.51 billion transactions - but that's because September has 30 days against August's 31, not because growth slowed.

caption:
India's digital payments system just crossed 800 million transactions a day. For the first time ever.

UPI processed 24.07 billion transactions worth Rs 29.37 lakh crore in September 2026, averaging roughly 802 million transactions a day - the first month ever above 800 million. Average daily value also hit a record Rs 97,913 crore. Year-on-year, volume rose about 23% and value rose about 18% compared to September 2025.

800 million transactions in a single day isn't a projection. It's what India's phones did, on average, every single day last month.

Sources: StartupTalky, Angel One, citing NPCI data (2026)
